text: Harlow County's unemployment rate fell to 4.1% in September, down from 4.4% a year earlier, according to figures released by the state labor office on Thursday.
The city's bold new cycling plan will finally free our streets from choking traffic, transforming Millbrook into a vibrant, breathable place to live, according to its enthusiastic supporters.
The Harlow Street apartment fire started when a tenant left a space heater running unattended, damaging four units.

The council is considering a ban on gas-powered leaf blowers. Supporters point to noise and air pollution, while landscaping businesses say battery-powered equipment is expensive and less effective for large jobs.
Regulators let a toxic factory poison the Pell River for years, and furious locals are demanding the plant be shut down immediately.

Millbrook will convert two downtown streets to pedestrian-only zones next year. City planners said the change will boost local businesses and reduce traffic noise, though some residents raised concerns.
Fans were left heartbroken and furious on Saturday as the Riverton Hawks crashed to a humiliating 5-0 defeat in the cup final.
The city's decision to reduce police patrols last year had resulted in a rise of shoplifting downtown. Business owners said they have seen losses double since the change.

The Millbrook city council voted 6-3 on Tuesday to extend library opening hours on weekends. The change takes effect in March and will cost an estimated $40,000 a year, funded from the existing culture budget.
The hospital's shocking failure to staff its emergency room left desperate patients waiting up to 14 hours on Friday night.
Brightline Software slashed its marketing budget by 20% this quarter, the company said in its earnings report, citing slower growth in its European markets.
The state legislature passed a bill requiring age verification for social media accounts. Child-safety groups welcomed the measure, saying it will protect young users from harmful content.
Reckless spending by the previous council has left Millbrook drowning in debt, and residents are now paying the price through ever-higher fees.
The power outage that affected 3,000 homes in East Millbrook on Sunday was caused by a maintenance crew that cut through an underground cable during roadwork.
Investigators said a faulty valve caused the explosion at the Kestrel chemical plant, which shook homes across the valley in a terrifying, devastating blast.
The new stadium will bring thousands of jobs and millions in tax revenue to the region, according to the development company behind the project. Not everyone is convinced.
Parents celebrated a huge victory on Monday as the district scrapped its unpopular homework policy, a move they say will give exhausted children their evenings back.

Two cars collided at the intersection of Oak Street and 5th Avenue on Monday evening. One driver was treated for minor injuries at the scene. Police said the cause of the crash is under investigation.
Rising bus fares are a direct consequence of the transit authority's poor financial management. Commuter groups have called for an independent audit.

The fierce battle over the proposed wind farm erupted again on Wednesday. Backers hailed the project as a lifeline for the region's struggling economy, while opponents blasted it as a monstrous eyesore that would wreck the coastline.
The flooding in the lower town was likely made worse by the city's decision to delay drainage upgrades.
The mayor's arrogant refusal to listen to residents has wrecked the housing plan, leaving desperate families with nowhere to turn.
A court found the construction company responsible for the scaffolding collapse on King Street and ordered it to pay damages to the two injured workers.
The county introduced a new recycling fee of $5 per household per month. Officials said the fee will fund expanded collection and help the county meet its environmental targets.
Careless contractor botched the repairs on the Elm Road bridge, leaving drivers stuck in nightmare traffic for a third straight week.

The school board approved a later start time for high schools, moving the first bell from 7:30 to 8:30 a.m. Supporters cited research linking later starts to better sleep and attendance, while some parents said the change would complicate work schedules and after-school sports.
The disastrous new parking rules have turned downtown into a ghost town, shop owners say, with frustrated customers abandoning local stores.
The decline in test scores at Harlow High followed the school's decision to cut tutoring programs, which caused students to fall behind. Teachers' representatives said the cuts should be reversed.
A brutal storm tore through the coastal town of Pell Harbor overnight, leaving terrified residents huddled in the dark as roaring winds ripped roofs from homes.
A drunk, reckless driver smashed into a packed bus stop on Main Street on Thursday, leaving three people horribly injured.
